integrity: Theorem established by case analysis and checked computationally on finite instances; experimental checks are not an infinite proof. Equal-length four-long-leg special case acknowledged as pre-existing; no external review.
scientific_limitations: Only mixed length-one/length-two spiders of central degree at least three; no classification for arbitrary arm lengths or maximal-sequence counts. Bibliographic incompleteness may persist.
title: Exact cooling thresholds for mixed depth-two spider trees
